MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Logitech PC speakers fit my interest in practical computer accessories, although I would only buy them if I needed to replace my current audio setup.",
    "Desktop audio has some connection to my earlier headset purchase, so I can see why it might interest me. That connection does not mean I need new speakers now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Alexa speakers, smart displays and television streaming devices do not solve the computer connection needs reflected in my recent adapter and cable purchases.",
    "The memory cards require a storage need and compatible device that I have not indicated, and my tablet mount purchase does not establish that I need a 14-inch tablet bag.",
    "A portable Bluetooth speaker serves a different purpose from my Anker USB expansion card; the shared brand does not make it a useful next purchase."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions treat a broad interest in electronics as a reason to offer smart-home and entertainment devices.",
    "Shared brands and mentions of tablets or audio seem to matter more than the specific job I needed each accessory to do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchases were a DVI cable and a USB-to-Ethernet adapter, which point toward connecting computer equipment rather than adding entertainment devices.",
    "My purchases are spread over years and address particular needs. Owning one accessory does not mean I am currently shopping for related equipment.",
    "Compatibility and a concrete use for an accessory matter to me; a loosely related product is not enough to make me buy."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my interest in computer accessories but stretched it into general electronics shopping without enough evidence of a current need."
}
